title: Ham and cheese sandwich
transcript: Go ahead. Okay guys, today we are making a ham and cheese sandwich. I'm going to show you how to do it, and how it should look like at each step. So, we start with the bread. I think the most important thing for the sandwich is the bread choice, so we are going with a regular sandwich bread. After we put it next to each other, we are going to apply our sauce. In this case, it's a mayo. Be careful not to apply too much, and try not to leave any blank points. In this case, like this. A bit more. After, we will have a lettuce. I think it will be enough, just two leaves, and if it's too big for it, you can tear it off a little bit, maybe like this. After, we will have our ham, and you can put it like this. One slice, two. Then, our cheese. And a pro tip: just be careful, don't put it in the middle like this, it should reach the edges, or greater. And we will close our sandwich, like this. It's already a sandwich. And at the end, we can cut it from corner to corner, like this, push gently. You will have a perfect ham and cheese sandwich. Like this.

steps.title: Lay out bread
steps.key_line: Two slices side by side, flat
steps.instruction: Start with regular sandwich bread: put two slices next to each other on the board, flat, not overlapping.
steps.chef_quote: So, we start with the bread.
success_criteria: Both slices lie flat on the table; neither is lifted up in a hand
The slices sit side by side without overlapping

watch_fors.mistake: One slice lies partly on top of the other
watch_fors.headline: Slices overlap
watch_fors.spoken: The slices are overlapping — lay them side by side so you can spread one.

steps.title: Spread
steps.key_line: Thin layer, right to every edge
steps.instruction: Apply the sauce (mayo here) to both slices: not too much, and leave no blank points, all the way to the crust.
steps.chef_quote: Be careful not to apply too much, and try not to leave any blank points.
success_criteria: Both slices have a thin layer of mayo over most of their surface
Neither slice has a large bare patch without mayo

watch_fors.mistake: Spread covers only the middle, leaving bare bread along the edges or corners
watch_fors.headline: Edges left bare
watch_fors.spoken: There's bare bread at the edges — take the spread right to the crust all the way round.

steps.title: Add lettuce
steps.instruction: Lay two lettuce leaves on one slice; if they're too big for it, tear a little off so they fit the bread.
steps.chef_quote: I think it will be enough, just two leaves, and if it's too big for it, you can tear it off a little bit, maybe like this.
success_criteria: Lettuce lies on one spread slice
The lettuce stays within the edges of the bread

steps.title: Add fillings
steps.key_line: One even layer, edge to edge
steps.instruction: Lay the ham on the lettuce, one slice, then two, then the cheese. The cheese reaches the edges of the bread instead of sitting in the middle.
steps.chef_quote: Just be careful, don't put it in the middle like this, it should reach the edges, or greater.
success_criteria: Ham and a slice of cheese are both on the bread, the cheese on top
The cheese reaches the edges of the bread instead of sitting in the middle

watch_fors.mistake: Filling is piled in the middle, bare bread around it
watch_fors.headline: Filling piled up
watch_fors.spoken: The filling is all in the middle — spread it out so it reaches the edges of the bread.

steps.title: Close
steps.key_line: Spread side down, edges lined up
steps.instruction: Close the sandwich with the second slice on top.
steps.chef_quote: And we will close our sandwich, like this. It's already a sandwich.
success_criteria: The second slice sits on top: one stacked sandwich, not two separate slices
The edges of the two slices line up

watch_fors.mistake: The top slice is shifted, leaving part of the filling uncovered
watch_fors.headline: Slices not lined up
watch_fors.spoken: The top slice has slipped — line its edges up with the bottom slice.

steps.title: Cut
steps.key_line: Corner to corner, one clean cut
steps.instruction: Cut the sandwich once, from corner to corner, pushing gently.
steps.chef_quote: And at the end, we can cut it from corner to corner, like this, push gently.
success_criteria: The knife has gone all the way through: two separate halves
The cut runs from one corner to the opposite corner
